svg.text: Josh E. Soussan is a BSc student in AI, Data & Management Sciences at CentraleSupélec ×
ESSEC, with a perfect 4.00/4 GPA. He builds quantitative tools where finance meets
machine learning: portfolio optimisation, risk and valuation engines, forecasting ensembles
and LLM agents, shipped as real software. Previously on desks at LCH (London Stock
Exchange Group), SIX Financial Information and Deloitte.
